name: PR Brief card renders the seeded risk level and review focus, and a focus entry navigates into Files changed
description: From PR #482's Overview tab, confirm the seeded PR Brief card renders above the Intent/Blast Radius grid: its risk level ('High risk'), all three seeded REVIEW FOCUS entries (including one kept without a line, AC-25), and the zero-cost provenance line ('$0', not 'Cost unknown' — AC-9/AC-10). Clicking the focus entry for src/config.ts:12 (the only seeded file with a real patch) switches to the Files changed tab and reveals that exact diff row. Read-only seeded data (server/src/db/seed.ts writes the pr_brief row directly) — never triggers POST /pulls/:id/brief/generate. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
PR Brief card title is visible
seeded risk level renders as a text label
review focus section heading is visible
first review-focus entry shows file and line
second review-focus entry shows file and line
third review-focus entry (no line, AC-25) renders the file with no line number
zero-cost provenance renders as a price, not 'Cost unknown' (AC-9, AC-10)
click the review-focus entry into its diff location
Files changed tab is active in the URL
the diff row the entry points at is actually reached (its group and file card are open)
